name: Service Scheduling
description: Generic service booking, provider scheduling, and route-aware dispatch: self-service booking portal, runtime service catalog, skill- and travel-matched recurring appointments, pre-shift check-ins, and live GPS ETA alerts.
description_zh: 通用服务预约、人员排程与路径感知调度工作区：支持在线自助预约门户、可配置服务目录、技能与路程匹配的周期预约、班前确认与实时 GPS 到达预警。
